question: In which game, when the score between two players is 40-40, is it called a deuce?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tennis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 

 **Important Terms in Tennis**
 **Significance**
 
 

 **Deuce**
 **When the score between two players is 40-40. A player must win two consecutive points to win the game.**
 
 

 Baseline
 The line at the back of the court runs parallel to the net.
 
 

 Break
 Breaking the service as the receiving player, because the server is more likely to win the game.
 
 

 Breakpoint
 
 
When two conditions occur:

 __
 
• One player is one point away to win the game.
 
• The opponent player is serving.
 
 
 
 

 Shots
 Tennis shots can be classified as serve, groundstroke, volley, and half-volley.
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Games**
 **Major Tournaments**
 
 

 **Tennis**
 **Davis Cup, Australian Open, French Open, US Open, Wimbledon.**
 
 

 Hockey
 Sultan Azlan Shah Cup, Aga Khan Cup, Maharaja Ranjit Singh Gold Cup, Dhyanchand Trophy, Sindhia Gold Cup.
 
 

 Badminton
 Thomas Cup (men), Uber Cup (women), Denmark Open, Malaysian Open, Sophia Cup, and Konica Cup.
 
 

 Chess
 King Salman World Chess Championship, Norway Chess Group A Open Chess Tournament, World Chess Championship.
